question: In zod 4.4.3's v4 core, what field was added to the internal ParsePayload interface to let an outer .optional() discard a .catch()/.transform() result when the input was undefined; which internals set or propagate it; and how does handleOptionalResult use it?
critical_facts: identifies the added field as `fallback` (a boolean) on the internal ParsePayload interface
states it is set by $ZodCatch (when the catch value substitutes) and by successful forward $ZodTransform invocations, and threaded across pipe boundaries
states handleOptionalResult now returns undefined when input === undefined and (there are issues OR result.fallback is set)
material_errors: names a public or user-facing option/flag instead of the internal `fallback` field
claims the mechanism is part of the public API
